final_message:
I fixed `slugify` so accented letters are kept as their plain ASCII forms. `"Café Münster"` now gives `cafe-munster`, where before it gave `caf-m-nster`. The existing 5 tests pass.

I guessed at the bug. You said only that some inputs go wrong, and accented letters were the likeliest cause I could see in the code. If users are reporting something else, send me an example input and the output they expected.

The fix is in `src/slugify.py`: the text is normalized to Unicode NFKD form and then reduced to ASCII before the existing regex runs.

Characters with no ASCII equivalent, such as CJK or emoji, are still dropped. A title made only of those gives an empty slug. I didn't add a test for the accent case.
